body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> Bluebird (www.bluebird.co.kr) has presented its new PDA(model : BM-150), which work with ‘CDMA & WLAN’ or ‘CDMA & GPS’. According to your particular communication environment, you can choose either ‘CDMA & WLAN’ or ‘CDMA & GPS’. you can also use it for voice/data communication or navigation system. It is equipped with ‘Windows CE 5.0’ and ‘Intel PXA270 520MHz CPU’. It also features video clips accelerator, 2mega CMOS camera, and MP3P. The company said that since it is particularly designed for industrial use, it is sturdy and useful tool for those working in the financial market. <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
